text:
A slow overnight fermentation develops the flavor of a sourdough loaf, and a warm kitchen helps the crumb open during the final proof. Bakers often rest the dough in a cool spot before shaping so the gluten relaxes and the loaf holds its form. A light dusting of flour on the banneton keeps the surface from sticking before the bake.
Debrief DB-021
1) The actor filed the plan behind an unrelated kitchen note, leaving the case exhibit physically separated from the rest of the file.
2) The actor recorded a multi-step harassment sequence covering utilities, locks, notices, and habitability, leaving the written scheme on file.
3) The actor described cutting utilities to pressure occupants out, leaving a documented intent to create uninhabitable conditions.
4) The actor planned lock changes to exclude the tenant, leaving the plan as a concrete step in the exhibit.
5) The actor intended to send threatening notices, leaving a stated method of intimidation in the record.
6) The actor outlined steps to avoid housing inspectors, leaving a documented attempt to evade regulatory oversight.
